patch_description: The current layout uses 5 staggered rows (6,5,6,5,6 with the top row truncated to 4), so the arrangement doesn't fill the square vertically — the rows only span about 0.744 of the unit height. Two improvements: (1) center the rows vertically so wall distances are larger and more balanced; (2) replace the overly conservative "half nearest-neighbor distance" radius rule with an iterative fixed-point relaxation: start each radius at its full wall distance (allowing circles to grow where there is free space, e.g. the truncated top row and near walls), then repeatedly cap r_i = min(wall_i, min_j (d_ij - r_j)). This converges to a maximal valid packing where each circle is as large as possible given its neighbors, exploiting the extra space left by the two removed circles and the vertical margins, which should push the sum of radii well above the current 2.17.
